description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be deprecated.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用[DescribeSubscriptionInstances](~~49442~~)接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the [DescribeSubscriptionInstances](~~49442~~) operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh: 订阅对象，格式为JSON串且支持一定的正则表达式，详细说明请参见[订阅对象配置说明](~~141902~~)。
description.en: The subscription objects. The value is a JSON string that supports regular expressions. For more information, see [Subscription object configuration](~~141902~~).
